title: Build the answer one radix at a time
hook: Build the answer one radix at a time. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Integer remainders, gcd, primes, modular exponentiation.
doesNotKnow: Reconstruct a CRT answer in mixed-radix digits instead of one giant weighted sum.

misconception: CRT reconstruction always needs intermediate products as large as all moduli multiplied together.
objective: Reconstruct a CRT answer in mixed-radix digits instead of one giant weighted sum.

claims.text: Each mixed-radix digit preserves all previous congruences because its place value is their modulus product. A modular inverse chooses the next digit to satisfy the newly added residue.
